text:
julia.eng: Quick question — my client meeting in Madrid ran late so I took a late-night taxi to a short-stay apartment for safety. Total taxi + 6-hour apartment = \u20ac120. I also claimed full per-diem for that day. Is that ok?

carmen.peopleops: Safety-related short stays and emergency transit are reimbursable. For per-diem, we treat meals as usual; lodging for partial nights is allowed as Transit/Lodging.

tom.finance: Please split the line items in the expense: taxi (Travel > Ground) and apartment (Travel > Lodging Transit). Attach the trip itinerary and note "safety rest due to late meeting". If the apartment was rented via a consumer marketplace, include host receipt + card statement.

julia.eng: The apartment host only sent a single receipt covering cleaning fee and whole stay, no breakdown. How should I submit?

carmen.peopleops: Use a pro-rata allocation: show hours used for business travel vs personal. Example: 6-hour apartment used entirely as transit rest after client meeting = 100% business. If personal activities occurred, split accordingly. Tag your manager for approval.

tom.finance: For consumer-marketplace bookings, we may flag VAT recovery as not available. Still reimbursable. For amounts > \u20ac200 we might ask for written manager approval in the expense notes.

julia.eng: I also grabbed a takeaway dinner from a nearby spot during the stay. Do I still reduce per-diem because of the apartment?

carmen.peopleops: No automatic reduction for lodging. Per-diem applies to meals. If the apartment included complimentary meals (rare), deduct those. Otherwise your takeaway counts toward meal consumption and can be included within per-diem or submitted separately if you prefer itemized reimbursement.

expensebot: Reminder: apply correct cost_center and project_code. Use Travel template to avoid routing delays. Missing approver will return the expense.

julia.eng: Lost the taxi receipt (card shows charge). Is that enough?

carmen.peopleops: Card statement + trip log + short note is OK for small taxi amounts (< \u20ac75). If taxi > \u20ac75, please request a replacement receipt from the driver/company.

tom.finance: Sample note to paste:
```
Late client meeting 2026-01-14. Transit lodging for safety (6h) and taxi to safe accommodation.
- Taxi: \u20ac20 (card)
- Transit apartment: \u20ac100 (6h) 
Per-diem claimed for full day. Manager @marco.sales approved 2026-01-15.
```

julia.eng: Thanks, submitting now. Appreciate the quick help. :pray:
